label: Boards
recap: Built a Next.js 16 board-game reservation app (BondarGames) — Prisma + Neon Postgres, NextAuth v5 (Google + Credentials with email-verified gating), nodemailer, admin-confirmed events with public/private modes (per-person vs flat pricing), a 24-hour week timeline, and a Docker-compose dev DB. Iterated heavily on the design: settled on a self-made CSS + SVG `feDisplacementMap` liquid-glass system (after trying and reverting `liquid-glass-react` and FluidGlass) with a neutral light palette. Latest pass made the navbar a fixed full-width bar with a mobile hamburger menu and gave the timeline a horizontally-scrollable grid with a sticky hour column; build is green and nothing has been committed since the early commits per your "don't commit" instruction.
